memories.content: Use `scripts/release-dashboard.sh <version> --notes-file <path>` for non-interactive dashboard releases; it bumps tauri.conf.json, updates the README link, waits for CI/assets, and publishes the draft release with notes.
Use `scripts/wait-release.sh <tag>` for plugin release polling because release.yml runs on tag refs and `gh run list` must filter with `--branch <tag>`.
Restart `opencode serve` after rebuilding the plugin, as restarting only the TUI or desktop client does not reload the server-side bundle.

TUI plugin code is exported via the `./tui` export in `package.json` (pointing to `src/tui/entry.mjs` which resolves raw `index.tsx` or compiled fallback), allowing TUI changes to take effect without rebuilding the server bundle.
Discord release announcements run inline from release.yml after github-release; the standalone Discord workflow is manual-only.
Cache-safety-affecting changes require a detailed plan, adversarial Oracle review, explicit approval for high-risk work, unit/e2e coverage, and live wire-level byte-diff verification before shipping.
Heuristic cleanup runs on execute passes, flushes, and emergency bands, bypassing the once-per-turn guard for subagents (to prevent overflow) and known m[0] hard folds.
For dashboard macOS distribution, use a Developer ID Application .p12 plus App Store Connect notarization credentials; Apple Development certificates are not valid for distributable notarized builds.

Historian prompt experiments use packages/plugin/scripts/test-historian-prompt.ts with real raw ranges, production-like existing state, and per-run prompt/input/output artifacts recording input and output tokens.
For historian replay experiments and long-running harness tasks, use `background: true` MCP bash tasks instead of `nohup ... &` so completion reminders fire.

For SCBench Magic Context runs, include child-session costs from subagent_invocations in the +MC arm and run baseline and +MC arms on the same OpenCode version, model, thinking level, prompt, environment, and problem set.

Code comments must explain the WHY of the code (invariant, failure mode, constraint) and must not reference ephemeral process artifacts like council numbers, audit findings, Oracle reviews, or plan version numbers.
When intentionally keeping an audit-flagged pattern, add inline comments so later audits treat it as reviewed.
For council plan audits, use blind methodology: do not disclose prior audit history or "verify these findings are closed" framing, which causes checklist-verification bias.
When patch rounds repeatedly introduce new defects in the same document, delegate patch work to a fresh model holding the plan + audit findings but no accumulated patch context.
Parallel or delegated implementation uses isolated worktrees or independent checkouts with explicit file-ownership boundaries; copy ignored .alfonso plans/artifacts into the worktree before resuming.
During plugin publishing, the release workflow copies root README.md to generated packages/plugin/README.md instead of maintaining a tracked duplicate.
Tauri capabilities must not enable `shell:default`.

The agent uses the wrapper `gh-alfonso-mc` at `~/.local/bin/gh-alfonso-mc` (sets `GH_CONFIG_DIR` to `~/.config/gh-alfonso-mc`) for all agent-authored GitHub actions to authenticate as `@alfonso-magic-context`. It is NOT on bash tool PATH by default — export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" first.
`build-reference-seeds.ts` runs `biome check --write` with cwd set to the plugin package root so the generated reference seed file falls within biome's include scope.

Agent commits must use the repo's configured git identity `ualtinok <ufukaltinok@gmail.com>` as author (just `git commit`, do NOT pass `--author` or `-c user.email` overrides) and append the trailer `Co-authored-by: Alfonso [Magic Context] <288211368+alfonso-magic-context@users.noreply.github.com>`. ufukaltinok@gmail.com is verified on the user's GitHub account so commits show as `ualtinok` with their avatar; hardcoding ufuk@earendil.works or ufuk@nowhere.dev breaks attribution (GitHub shows a plain name, no avatar).

Configuration schema updates are made by editing the Zod schema MagicContextConfigSchema (packages/plugin/src/config/schema/magic-context.ts), using Zod .describe() calls for field documentation as the single source of truth, and running bun packages/plugin/scripts/build-schema.ts to regenerate assets/magic-context.schema.json.

Test database isolation uses two layers to prevent tests from modifying the production database: (1) packages use bunfig.toml to preload settings mapping MAGIC_CONTEXT_TEST_DATA_DIR and XDG_DATA_HOME to temp directories, and (2) resolveDatabasePath redirects to a temporary directory if NODE_ENV is "test" and paths are unset.

Use scripts/release.sh <version> to run lint, typecheck, test, and E2E checks, generate the JSON schema and reference seed assets, re-lint for formatting drift, sync versions, and commit, tag, and push the release.
To surface an `m[1]` delta in E2E tests, write an empty `m[0]` first to freeze the watermark on the first pass, then append the compartment or memory and execute a subsequent cache-busting pass.
Historian mock ordinal parsing in tests uses the line-anchored regex `/^\[(\d+)\] [UA]:/` scoped to `<new_messages>` to avoid matching literal brackets in prose.
OpenCode host-E2E test runs explicitly append the oracle unit test `src/cache-analysis.test.ts` because it lies outside the `tests/*.test.ts` glob.
Project configurations must not contain `sqlite.*` settings; they are stripped at load time for security.
release.yml gates npm publish and GitHub release jobs on unit checks, Docker E2E, and host behavior E2E to prevent releases when tests are failing.
Plugin releases require a tracked `.alfonso/release-notes/<tag>.md` file as the curated GitHub release body, which release.yml automatically uploads via body_path.
Primary agents may only merge memories belonging to their own resolved project; cross-project memory merge is restricted to the dreamer.
Tool tagging must bump the tag's byte size and token counts in the database if a later occurrence (e.g. tool result) carries a larger payload than the initial occurrence.
Sidekick is restricted to read-only memory access and must not mutate ctx_memory.
Releases require a clean audit (0 P0 and 0 P1) across all councils before shipping.

Debugging cache busts requires establishing the timeline from logs and using wire-dump byte diffs via bun packages/plugin/scripts/analyze-cache-busts.ts to attribute prompt changes, rather than using ad-hoc diff scripts or provider explanations.

The ctx_reduce tool description and guidance must frame it as deferred discard (queuing a pending operation) rather than immediate delete to encourage models to call it earlier. Safety guidance must focus on whether the information is no longer needed, cautioning that once discarded, the content is replaced by a placeholder and cannot be retrieved.

The dreamer's maintain-docs task must reproduce sections in ARCHITECTURE.md enclosed in <!-- mc:protected START --> and <!-- mc:protected END --> comments byte-for-byte. These protected regions must not be edited or removed when rewriting or regenerating the file.
Per-turn handlers (such as system-prompt injection) must fail open to prevent throwing errors into the main prompt path.
Defer deep refactors of TypeScript plugin transform and cache logic in transform.ts and inject-compartments.ts to align with the planned transition to a shared Rust MC module.
Keep the Magic Context entry default export as the `{ id, server }` object; never add named exports to packages/plugin/src/index.ts to avoid triggering the legacy loader's export scan.
Maintain-memory harness trials run on a disposable copy of context.db created via SQLite online backup to protect production data.
Questions about OpenCode or Pi internals and behavior must be sent to the registered peer 'OC' or 'PI' via peer_send instead of reading their respective source code.
When asked to find, diagnose, or investigate an issue, locate and report the cause using search and read tools without modifying any files until instructed to apply a fix.

Use `setup` for first-time or full interactive installation, `doctor` for existing installs, and `doctor --force` to clear the cached plugin install when a stale dependency tree breaks plugin loading even though the cached version matches.

Docker smoke E2E runs from tests/docker/ via run-e2e.sh once packages/plugin and packages/pi-plugin builds exist, followed by host behavior E2E suites from packages/e2e-tests. E2E tests must run locally (especially after changes to packages/e2e-tests) on an idle host without concurrent shell work to prevent timing-related flakiness, with inherited NODE_ENV unset and `~/.opencode/bin` added to the PATH for OpenCode subprocesses.

Before committing release-bound changes or merging delegated work, independently audit diffs and rerun typecheck, lint, build, and all relevant tests (including the full test suite for any changes to shared call paths). For workflow changes, push to master and wait for the gated CI pipeline to pass before tagging a release.

Release work and related GitHub issues close only after verifying CI, package publication, GitHub release, and announcement completion; existing release notes remain unchanged with corrections shipping in a new patch release.

When tuning historian or compressor prompts, cross-validate on other sessions to avoid overfitting, and cross-check aggregate metrics by inspecting representative compartments to prevent narrative regressions.
Subagents running in hidden background processes must not be prompted to output reasoning.
The dream-timer scheduler startup must fail open (catching database open throws) to prevent storage failures from disabling the core transform and compaction pipeline.
English README is canonical; translations are best-effort and may lag.
Translate prose only in README translations, keeping code blocks, config/JSONC examples, commands, links, badge URLs, and heading anchors verbatim.
Masons/subagents performing translations must not use external translation tools or APIs (such as translate-shell/trans) and must perform translations directly.

CI's "Check" job runs `biome check .` (lint AND format verification) repo-wide per package. Local pre-push verification MUST run the exact `bun run lint` (= `biome check .`) for every touched package, not scoped `biome check <subpath>` or `format --write` on touched files only — scoped/format-write runs miss whole-file format drift (import wrapping, quote style, JSX) and let CI lint go red even when targeted checks pass.
E2E and unit tests that open a writable context DB handle must set a `busy_timeout` (e.g., 5000ms) to prevent SQLITE_BUSY lock-contention flakes under loaded CI.
Keep docs/cache-policy/ and docs/specs/ directories gitignored and local-only to prevent internal design discussions from leaking to public repositories.

The MC harness-agnostic Rust module (crates/mc-core, mc-store, mc-module→binary ck-mc, mc-tokenizer + root Cargo workspace) is PUBLIC on origin/master as of 2026-07-10 (Ufuk-approved merge of subc-migration, SHA ab196741, CI green) — the local-branch-only era and its push-hold are OVER. subc-migration continues as the working branch but now merges to master + pushes normally (master pushes still require Ufuk's go-ahead; npm releases fire only on v* tags). Prod runs ck-mc from target/release/ck-mc (source-identical to origin/master crates/), supervised by subc; owned leg = BROCA (ex llm-runner; historian producer targets module_id "broca", serializer profile owned-broca with owned-llmrunner registered until deletable), CC leg = THALAMUS (ex ai-proxy) on port 8378. WORKFLOW for worktree changes stays: verify at source in the mason worktree → FF-merge into subc-migration → gate the LIVE merged tree → Oracle/contract pass → keep or reset (memory 7871). ARCHITECTURE: mc-module OWNS reduction logic; cache-core stays dumb. CODEC OWNERSHIP SPLIT: spec-#2 section E = harness-model codecs (MC-owned, shipped); section F = provider-wire codecs (BROCA-owned); MC never sees provider wire. Epoch contract with THALAMUS: memory 8664. Remaining tails: section-E projection oracles (note #452), deferred-marker activations (notes #412/#409), observer-mode for CC spinner passes (note #527), owned-llmrunner profile deletion post-cut.
The workspace-union memory read must fail loud if no project identity is bound, preventing cross-project read hazards.

Every cache-critical slice of the harness-agnostic MC Rust module (crates/mc-*, subc-migration branch) must pass TWO orthogonal review surfaces before commit: (1) a cache-CONTRACT review (freeze/replay discipline, the SOFT/SOFT+/HARD taxonomy, digest completeness, the determinism axes — defer composes no body, expiry/budget frozen, fingerprints canonical) and (2) an independent adversarial DATA-FLOW review of the compose internals (which bytes the producers actually emit — union-memory visibility, coverage tiling, watermark routing). These find DISJOINT bug classes: on slice 4d-m0 the contract pass cleared correctly while the data-flow Oracle caught 2 reachable data-correctness P0s the contract review structurally cannot see. Neither surface alone is sufficient. No commit may ride over a known P0; resolve or correctly-reclassify all findings from both surfaces first.

Oracle/gate reviews of mason worktree changes must run AFTER merging the fix into the session-cwd branch (e.g. FF-merge into subc-migration), not while the change is worktree-only. A subagent's relative-path reads (crates/..., src/...) resolve to the SESSION CWD, not the mason's worktree, so gating a worktree-only change makes the Oracle read the pre-fix base and emit a false BLOCK ("symbol absent / still old code"). For local integration branches this is safe because the merge is trivially revertible (git reset --hard <base>) with no downstream consumer. Order: verify at source in the worktree → FF-merge into cwd branch → gate the live merged tree → SUBC/contract re-pass → keep or reset.
When debugging structured-stream consumer failures, check for interleaved non-JSON or plain-text noise in the stream.
Do not call `getWritableOpenCodeDb` or write OpenCode compaction markers on non-OpenCode harnesses.

Every agent-authored git commit must end with the trailer "Co-authored-by: Alfonso [Magic Context] <288211368+alfonso-magic-context@users.noreply.github.com>" (bot account alfonso-magic-context, id 288211368), mirroring the AFT agent convention.

Plugin tests must NEVER spawn real git processes (execFileSync/execFile of git, `git init` fixtures). On loaded macOS machines, spawned-binary assessment (syspolicyd) stalls each spawn 30-170+s, failing the release gate's local test run while CI stays green. Use the injectable exec seams instead: __setProjectIdentityTestHooks({ execFileSync }) in memory/project-identity.ts and the verification-paths seam for verify-gate reads; create real `.git` DIRECTORIES on disk when a test needs the stat-walk/ancestor/symlink detection exercised (the walk checks existence, not validity), and script git OUTPUT through the seam. Grep guard: no `execFileSync("git"` / `execFile("git"` in *.test.ts.
Use the shared `runLeaseGuardedWrite` helper (which uses `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` transactions) for all lease-guarded database writes to prevent double-commits under SQLite WAL snapshot isolation.
Memory manifest parsers must use fail-closed root-element parsing instead of regex-scanning tags to prevent truncated LLM outputs from triggering unintended memory mutations.
Every dev-rig must pin a unique port (e.g., 8811) to avoid loopback port collisions on 8757 with production subc-core.

CC-leg reclaim arc CLOSED (2026-07-09, all deployed to prod + drive-proven from both sides' instruments): three stacked bugs each hid the next — (1) historian substance floor blocked all folds on the verbatim-tail CC leg (fixed: bypass on !tail_reclaim profiles + A' newest-arc boundary guard + AIPROXY's 167k CC denominator); (2) CC spinner side-requests forked the lineage every real turn so folds never accumulated depth (fixed: AIPROXY Fix C trailing-swap + C-2 swap+append predicates); (3) covered mid-array system messages re-emitted as [m0(user), system, m1(user)] which Anthropic 400s ("system must precede assistant or end array") — the 400 fell back to raw retry, silently eating the reclaim (fixed: covered systems absorb into m0 as a <covered-system-messages> text block, dedup byte-identical first-ordinal, block omitted when empty; plus AIPROXY fail-closed validate fence). Final proof: 23.4k tokens reclaimed on-wire and held flat (86k→110k→[fold]→87k), one lineage, zero fences, received==forwarded coverage across all 17 passes.
Run the full test suite in directory slices rather than as a monolith to prevent exceeding tool execution caps.
Pi doctor must open the shared database read-only to prevent schema migrations during diagnostic runs.

Compartment write paths (historian append, recompilation promotion, partial-recompilation preservation, and staging round-trip) preserve the p1-p4 tier columns in the compartments and recomp_compartments tables to prevent losing multi-level compressed paraphrases during context updates.

In packages/plugin/src/features/magic-context/compartment-storage.ts and compartment-lease.ts, compartment-state mutations verify a DB-backed compartment_state_lease inside a BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction to coordinate concurrent OpenCode and Pi processes sharing the database.
In packages/plugin/src/shared/models-dev-cache.ts, resolveLimit prefers limit.input over limit.context to align context pressure calculations with provider-enforced input limits.
In packages/plugin/src/config/schema/magic-context.ts, the execute threshold is capped at a maximum of 80% to keep the history compression budget within the usable execution window.
Caveman/density-aware compression persists result depth in tags and replays from the stored depth on every pass to prevent defer passes from restoring the original long text.
The dreamer processes scheduled tasks filtered by projectIdentity to prevent executing tasks in incorrect directories or client scopes.

In packages/plugin/src/plugin/dream-timer.ts, scheduled dreamer checks run from a single process-wide, plugin-level timer instead of message.updated hooks to ensure they execute when the user is idle.
unifiedSearch computes a single query embedding and shares it across semantic memory and git-commit searches to prevent duplicate HTTP requests.

In packages/plugin/src/features/magic-context/git-commits/git-log-reader.ts, git commit indexing uses HEAD-only non-merge history and reads git log with \x1f field separators to prevent errors in Node execFile and preserve commit-body formatting.
In packages/plugin/src/features/magic-context/message-index.ts, raw message search uses a lazy incremental FTS5 index in the magic-context SQLite database to avoid writing to the OpenCode database.

In packages/plugin/src/features/magic-context/search.ts, unifiedSearch excludes memories already rendered in the session history (visibleMemoryIds) and raw-message hits newer than the last compartment end (maxMessageOrdinal) since the live tail is already in context.
OpenCode serializes msgs to model messages after messages.transform fires so Magic Context message-array mutations land before provider serialization.
In packages/plugin/src/hooks/magic-context/compaction-marker-manager.ts, OpenCode compaction markers store a static placeholder summary so filterCompacted stops at the historian boundary.

In packages/plugin/src/agents/permissions.ts, hidden Magic Context agents use allow-only OpenCode permission maps (wildcard-deny first, then explicit allows) because prompt-based sessions do not receive the default subagent auto-deny wrapper.
Config loading deep-merges raw user and project JSONC before Zod parsing so defaults fill only keys unset by both.
Pi uses per-session RawMessageProvider overrides so shared chunking/formatting runs on Pi session data without converting to OpenCode MessageLike.

In packages/plugin/src/hooks/magic-context/command-handler.ts, /ctx-aug appends retrieved memory context in a <sidekick-augmentation> block to the user prompt, rather than modifying the cached project-memory block in message[0], to preserve the Anthropic prompt cache.
In packages/cli/src/adapters/opencode.ts, setup merges required edits into existing config files to preserve local configuration entries and comments.

In packages/cli/src/lib/find-on-path.ts, CLI host detection (including OpenCode and Pi) walks the PATH using Node primitives rather than shelling out to which or where to reliably support wrapper scripts and sandboxed environments.

In packages/plugin/src/hooks/magic-context/inject-compartments.ts, model key switches, system prompt hash changes, and idle TTL timeouts trigger a hard M0 materialization (folding M1 into M0) to align with provider-side cache evictions.

In packages/plugin/src/hooks/magic-context/system-prompt-hash.ts and packages/pi-plugin/src/system-prompt.ts, system-prompt date stabilization freezes the 'Today's date' line until the next cache-busting pass to prevent midnight date rollovers from busting the prompt-cache.
Temporal awareness uses deterministic HTML gap comments on live user messages and start-date / end-date attributes on rendered compartments to ensure compact and cache-stable signals.
Database migrations tolerate `schema_migrations` primary key conflicts to prevent crashes during concurrent startup of multiple plugin processes.
Pi entry ID resolution uses Map<AgentMessage, entryId> reference identity with fingerprint fallback because agent.state.messages can diverge from getBranch().

In packages/pi-plugin/src/tools/index.ts, registerMagicContextTools registers project-scoped tools but omits session-scoped tools (ctx_note, ctx_expand) when opts.sessionScopedToolsDisabled is true to prevent child subagents from writing orphaned state or expanding empty transcripts.
Auto-search calls unifiedSearch with countRetrievals: false so hint lookups do not increment counters or promote memories.
Compartment p1_embedding generation is best-effort and fire-and-forget to prevent blocking or failing historian publication.

In packages/plugin/src/shared/sqlite.ts, the SQLite adapter dynamically imports bun:sqlite or node:sqlite using runtime string concatenation and /* @vite-ignore */ comments to avoid build-time resolution errors.
Project-level configurations do not expand {env:VAR} or {file:path} tokens to prevent secret exfiltration.
In packages/pi-plugin/src/index.ts, Pi's session_before_compact event handler returns { cancel: true } to cancel native compaction and yield control of compaction boundaries to Magic Context.
Key-files injection uses project_key_files_version counters to invalidate active per-session caches across processes after key file modifications.
Deferred native `appendCompaction()` markers are staged in `session_meta` and drain on the next materializing pass to update the `getBranch()` compacted view.
DCP detection matches only on canonical package names to avoid false-positive path matches.
In packages/plugin/src/tui/data/context-db.ts, the TUI data layer retrieves all data from the server plugin via RPC and performs no direct SQLite operations to avoid database lock contention.

packages/e2e-tests/src/cache-analysis.ts extracts extractM0 and extractM1 at the text block level instead of the message level because same-role user messages are merged into a single message with multiple text blocks.

In packages/plugin/src/hooks/magic-context/event-handler.ts, internal child sessions (historian, dreamer, sidekick, and memory-migration) are identified by a 'magic-context-' title prefix to exempt them from system-prompt injection and the transform pipeline.

In packages/plugin/src/hooks/magic-context/emergency-drop.ts, emergency tool drop uses priorInputSample (persisted as last_emergency_input_sample in storage-meta-persisted.ts) as the idempotence latch to prevent repeated drops on the same input token count.
The emergency tool drop identifies candidates using status='active' in the database instead of a scalar watermark to prevent premature exclusion of lower-tier tags.

In packages/plugin/src/hooks/magic-context/protected-tail-boundary.ts, the protected-tail token target N is capped at 0.40 * usable (MAX_USABLE_RATIO) to prevent deadlocks on models with small context sizes.

In packages/plugin/src/features/magic-context/storage-db.ts and storage-tags.ts, token_count, input_token_count, and reasoning_token_count are cached in the tags table to enable fast SQL sums for sidebar and boundary token calculations.

packages/plugin/src/hooks/magic-context/compartment-runner-incremental.ts promotes emitted facts directly to project memory via promoteSessionFactsDurable, bypassing session_facts to avoid unnecessary compartment rebuilds.

checkCompartmentTrigger primes the raw-message cache using either an in-memory messages tail (via primeInMemoryTailRawMessageCache) or a tail-only database read (via primeTailRawMessageCache) starting from lastCompartmentEnd to avoid full-session DB reads.

In packages/plugin/src/hooks/magic-context/compartment-trigger.ts, checkCompartmentTrigger evaluates the tail_size trigger using TC-chunked (summarizable) tokenEstimate (triggerBudget * 3 or chunkHasMore) rather than true-raw occupancy, preventing over-compartmentalization on low-pressure, tool-heavy sessions.

In packages/plugin/src/features/magic-context/storage-db.ts, healWedgedChannel2Claims rewinds Channel-2 claims older than 120s (CHANNEL2_CLAIM_TTL_MS) to 'pending' during boot recovery to prevent concurrent processes from stealing active claims.

In packages/plugin/src/hooks/magic-context/ctx-reduce-availability.ts, the availability of ctx_reduce is resolved from the tools map of the first user message and cached in memory to prevent system-prompt hash oscillation.

In packages/plugin/src/features/magic-context/memory/cosine-similarity.ts and storage-memory-embeddings.ts, embeddings are stored as SQLite BLOBs and scanned in memory via Float32Array cosine similarity to avoid sqlite-vec write-amplification and runtime compatibility issues.

In packages/plugin/src/features/magic-context/storage-db.ts and packages/plugin/src/features/magic-context/migrations.ts, unique index idx_workspace_member_unique on workspace_members(project_path) constrains each project to at most one workspace to prevent budget and provenance ambiguity.

In packages/plugin/src/tools/ctx-memory/tools.ts and packages/pi-plugin/src/tools/ctx-memory.ts, memory update, archive, and merge operations execute under the target memory's resolved project identity instead of the active session's identity to ensure correct mutation logging and embedding routing.
In packages/dashboard/src-tauri/src/db.rs, SQLite connections are opened without SQLITE_OPEN_CREATE to delegate database schema lifecycle to the plugin.
External project-memory updates bump project_memory_epoch to force a hard M0 materialization, ensuring session context immediately reflects the updated memory store.

In packages/plugin/src/hooks/magic-context/compartment-runner-recomp.ts, context recompilation rebuilds the session's compartment structure from raw history but discards facts emitted by the historian to prevent re-promoting them into the curated project memory store.

In packages/plugin/src/hooks/magic-context/inject-compartments.ts, defer passes replay the cached compartment injection by trimming input messages to compartmentEndMessageId or reusing the cache if pruned, preventing mid-turn historian publications from invalidating the prompt-cache prefix.

In packages/plugin/src/features/magic-context/project-embedding-registry.ts, getChunkEmbeddingModelId includes chunk-window configurations in the chunk-specific model ID, so chunk-window updates do not invalidate memory or commit vectors which use only the provider identity.

In packages/pi-plugin/src/subagent-runner.ts, Pi subagents run as spawned subprocesses terminated via SIGTERM, while OpenCode subagents run as host-side fibers terminated via step caps or session aborts.

In packages/plugin/src/hooks/magic-context/read-session-true-raw-tokens.ts, fenceBoundaryForToolArcs protects open tool arcs from compaction only when they occur at or after recentOpenArcCutoff, preventing abandoned tool calls from freezing compaction.

In packages/plugin/src/hooks/magic-context/transform-postprocess-phase.ts, pending operations and heuristic cleanup bypass the compartment-running veto during forced materializations or hard M0 fold passes to execute drops directly during the unavoidable prompt-cache bust.

In packages/dashboard/src-tauri/src/db.rs, dashboard cache health classification predicts expected cache_read as the previous step's cache_read plus expected growth (prev.cache_write, or prev.input + prev.output if zero) to calculate retention and assign severities.

In packages/plugin/src/features/magic-context/transform-decision-log.ts and packages/dashboard/src-tauri/src/db.rs, dashboard cache cause attribution associates cache events with the transform_decisions table via message_id (for OpenCode) or the deferred SessionEntry wrapper ID (for Pi) to avoid log-parsing latency.

In packages/plugin/src/features/magic-context/tagger.ts, cache invalidation uses PRAGMA main.data_version instead of SQLite change counters to prevent same-connection writes from invalidating the in-memory tagger cache.

In packages/plugin/src/hooks/magic-context/transform.ts, tagger load-scoping derives the floor live from the first wire message ids on every pass instead of using a persisted watermark or flag, ensuring revert-safety without introducing stale state.

In packages/plugin/src/hooks/magic-context/apply-operations.ts, dropped tool calls within the RECENT_TOOL_SKELETON_WINDOW (20) truncate to a placeholder skeleton to prevent provider-side tool pairing mismatches, while older tool calls are fully removed from the transcript.
In-session memory mutations queue to the memory_mutation_log and render in the M1 delta to provide cache-stable incremental updates without rebuilding the M0 block.
Pi reasoning replay clears thinking fields and signatures on unredacted thinking content while skipping redacted blocks to maintain clean thinking logs.

packages/plugin/src/features/magic-context/memory/embedding-openai.ts: embeddingModelsMatch matches model names only on exact matches or token boundaries (- or /) to allow version expansion and vendor prefix trimming while preventing wrong-dimension corruption.

packages/plugin/src/tools/ctx-memory/tools.ts restricts the dreamer's cross-project memory merges to shared categories inside a workspace, while leaving cross-project merges outside workspaces unrestricted.
packages/plugin/src/plugin/dream-timer.ts executes drainCommitBacklogForProject after releasing the git-sweep lease to prevent self-deadlock.
Magic Context plans to migrate per-harness plugin transform and cache logic into a harness-agnostic Rust MC module (SUBC) communicating via IPC.
packages/plugin/src/hooks/magic-context/transform.ts gates recordSessionProjectIdentity calls using an in-process recordedSessionProjectIdentity map to prevent per-pass SQLite writes.
The plugin config hook must fail open (wrapped in try/catch) to prevent agent registration failures from disabling the core transform and compaction pipeline.

OpenCode's legacy loader iterates Object.values(mod) and invokes every exported function as a plugin factory if the default export is a function; exporting the V1 object shape { id, server } bypasses this scan entirely.

sendIgnoredMessage pins the last assistant turn's agent, model, and variant to prevent OpenCode's createUserMessage from recording default prompt-context and switching the active model on the next turn.

Local embedding initialization in packages/plugin/src/features/magic-context/memory/embedding-local.ts imports @huggingface/transformers via a non-literal string to bypass Bun static analysis, and injects onnxruntime-web into globalThis[Symbol.for("onnxruntime")] before the import to prevent native runtime load failures in Electron.

At or above 95% context usage, transform execution blocks to wait for the force-started historian agent run to prevent prompt truncation or OOM crashes, while below 95% the historian runs in the background to avoid freezing the UI.

The Dreamer V2 `classify-memories` task daily evaluates importance, scope, and shareability for each memory. The classification is written directly to the database to remain cache-neutral until the next non-classify materialization. Shareability check is fail-closed, scanning for sensitive text (secrets or personal paths) to enforce privacy regardless of the LLM classification, while memory importance score sorts the budget trim in the prompt.

MITM compaction design for Claude Code + Codex (settled + source-confirmed 2026-06-28). OpenCode/Pi rebuild the wire from their store EACH TURN, so store marker-injection drives LIVE compaction (plugin-path mechanism). Claude Code AND Codex do NOT: during a live session the wire is built from the IN-MEMORY conversation array; the on-disk store (~/.claude/projects/*.jsonl, ~/.codex/sessions/*.jsonl) is APPEND-ONLY write-through read ONLY at resume/startup. Verified three ways: (1) live PTY behavioral probe — set number 4471, edited disk to 9925 mid-session, model recalled 4471 (in-memory) on both; (2) binary recon — no session-file watch, watch/reload primitives target config/plugins/dev-server only; (3) Claude Code source ~/Work/OSS/claude-code (v1.0.0 ref): compaction = setMessages(old => getMessagesAfterCompactBoundary(old)) on the IN-MEMORY array; findLastCompactBoundaryIndex scans in-memory messages for a compact_boundary STREAMING-EVENT message (NOT the JSONL isCompactSummary entry); the only disk-session-read is loadConversationForResume, called ONLY at startup/--print/--resume. No file-watch, no signal/marker-triggered reload; the only force-reread lever is /resume (a session switch, not externally triggerable). CONSEQUENCE — the MITM live-compaction design is DUAL: (a) LIVE = in-memory VIRTUAL compaction marker held by the MITM daemon + request-rewrite of every intercepted outbound request to the compacted form (works because harness sends full history on the wire and we own the wire; this is what headroom ~/Work/OSS/headroom does in production); (b) RESTART PERSISTENCE = ALSO inject a real store marker (isCompactSummary / compacted+replacement_history) so a restart/resume loads from the compacted state instead of reverting to full history; (c) DISABLE native auto-compaction (DISABLE_AUTO_COMPACT / auto_compact_token_limit) so the harness does not compact on its own and fight the virtual boundary. So integration positions take different live mechanisms: plugin (OpenCode/Pi) = store marker-injection (re-read each turn); MITM (Claude Code/Codex) = in-memory virtual marker + request-rewrite, store marker only for restart persistence.
